_purpose: Rotation cursor for Cura's Translation-quality Phase-1 sub-check (Round 135). Tracks which lessons.md / operating-protocols.md / invariants.py entries have been audited recently, so Cura samples oldest-first and rotates through the corpus over time.
_format: Map of entry-identifier -> last-audited ISO timestamp. Identifier shape varies by file: lessons.md uses the entry's leading timestamp string (e.g., '2026-06-18 at 5:15 PM'), operating-protocols.md uses section number ('25'), invariants.py uses invariant name ('check_lesson_freshness_vs_saga').
_rotation_rule: Each Cura night samples 3-5 entries that have not been audited in the last 14 days, oldest-first. Updates this file at end of Phase 6 close with the entries audited this run.
_initialized: 2026-06-19 (Round 135 / Cure C ship — empty cursor, all entries treated as never-audited; first Cura run will sample from the most-recent end and work backward).
